papers.title: Tensor Computation: A New Framework for High-Dimensional Problems in EDA
papers.abstract: Many critical EDA problems suffer from the curse of dimensionality, i.e. the very fast-scaling computational burden produced by large number of parameters and/or unknown variables. This phenomenon may be caused by multiple spatial or temporal factors (e.g. 3-D field solvers discretizations and multi-rate circuit simulation), nonlinearity of devices and circuits, large number of design or optimization parameters (e.g. full-chip routing/placement and circuit sizing), or extensive process variations (e.g. variability/reliability analysis and design for manufacturability). The computational challenges generated by such high dimensional problems are generally hard to handle efficiently with traditional EDA core algorithms that are based on matrix and vector computation. This paper presents "tensor computation" as an alternative general framework for the development of efficient EDA algorithms and tools. A tensor is a high-dimensional generalization of a matrix and a vector, and is a natural choice for both storing and solving efficiently high-dimensional EDA problems. This paper gives a basic tutorial on tensors, demonstrates some recent examples of EDA applications (e.g., nonlinear circuit modeling and high-dimensional uncertainty quantification), and suggests further open EDA problems where the use of tensor computation could be of advantage.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文讨论电子设计自动化中的张量计算，与生物力学有限元代理建模及植入物设计无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on tensor methods for EDA problems and does not address any aspect of biomechanical simulation, surrogate modeling for FEA, design optimization, or implant-related validation.

summary_zh.motivation: EDA中高维问题计算负担大，传统矩阵方法效率低。
summary_zh.method: 提出张量计算框架，以张量替代矩阵存储和求解高维问题。
summary_zh.result: 通过非线性电路建模和高维不确定性量化展示了张量计算的潜力。
summary_zh.validation: 未提供实验验证，仅通过案例展示框架可行性。

summary_en.motivation: The curse of dimensionality creates prohibitive computational costs in many electronic design automation problems.
summary_en.method: This tutorial presents tensor computation as a general framework that uses tensors (high-dimensional generalizations of matrices) to efficiently represent and solve high-dimensional problems in EDA.
summary_en.result: Examples in nonlinear circuit modeling and high-dimensional uncertainty quantification demonstrate the potential advantages of tensor-based methods.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation is provided; the paper is a tutorial with illustrative examples only.

papers.title: Semi-Supervised Active Learning for Support Vector Machines: A Novel Approach that Exploits Structure Information in Data
papers.abstract: In our today's information society more and more data emerges, e.g.~in social networks, technical applications, or business applications. Companies try to commercialize these data using data mining or machine learning methods. For this purpose, the data are categorized or classified, but often at high (monetary or temporal) costs. An effective approach to reduce these costs is to apply any kind of active learning (AL) methods, as AL controls the training process of a classifier by specific querying individual data points (samples), which are then labeled (e.g., provided with class memberships) by a domain expert. However, an analysis of current AL research shows that AL still has some shortcomings. In particular, the structure information given by the spatial pattern of the (un)labeled data in the input space of a classification model (e.g.,~cluster information), is used in an insufficient way. In addition, many existing AL techniques pay too little attention to their practical applicability. To meet these challenges, this article presents several techniques that together build a new approach for combining AL and semi-supervised learning (SSL) for support vector machines (SVM) in classification tasks. Structure information is captured by means of probabilistic models that are iteratively improved at runtime when label information becomes available. The probabilistic models are considered in a selection strategy based on distance, density, diversity, and distribution (4DS strategy) information for AL and in a kernel function (Responsibility Weighted Mahalanobis kernel) for SVM. The approach fuses generative and discriminative modeling techniques. With 20 benchmark data sets and with the MNIST data set it is shown that our new solution yields significantly better results than state-of-the-art methods.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究半监督主动学习用于分类任务，与有限元代理建模无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on classification with active learning and semi-supervised SVMs, with no application to FEA, surrogate modeling, optimization, uncertainty quantification, or implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低分类任务中数据标注成本。
summary_zh.method: 结合半监督学习和主动学习，利用数据结构信息选择样本，融合生成式与判别式建模。
summary_zh.result: 在20个基准数据集和MNIST上显著优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 20个基准数据集和MNIST数据集上的数值实验。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce labeling costs in classification tasks by exploiting structure information in unlabeled data.
summary_en.method: A novel approach combining semi-supervised learning and active learning for SVM, using distance, density, diversity, and distribution information to select informative samples, and a Responsibility Weighted Mahalanobis kernel to incorporate structure information.
summary_en.result: The proposed method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on 20 benchmark datasets and the MNIST dataset.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on 20 datasets and the MNIST dataset.

papers.title: Bioinks for Biofabrication: Current State and Future Perspectives
papers.abstract: Recent progress in 3D printing technologies is leading a revolution in cell culture methods. These systems rely heavily on bioinks, the raw cells and biomaterials used to create these 3D cultures. These formulations, ranging from cell suspensions to hard acellular thermoplastics, must function with 3D systems and offer biocompatible environments that mimic in vivo tissue characteristics. Although much progress has been made for the production of increasingly complex reproducible 3D tissues, a full biofabrication platform with both improved technology and superior bioinks must be developed. Here, important properties for these materials are examined; recent advances in bioinks are summarized; and finally, future considerations for 3D biofabrication are discussed.

llm.why_not_core: No AI integration, no bioprinting workflow stage automation, no experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述生物墨水在3D生物打印中的重要性及当前进展
summary_zh.method: 通过文献调研总结生物墨水的关键特性和最新发展
summary_zh.result: 指出仍需开发兼具技术改进和优质生物墨水的完整生物制造平台
summary_zh.validation: 综述类型，未进行实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To review the critical properties and recent progress of bioinks for 3D bioprinting applications.
summary_en.method: A comprehensive literature survey summarizing key bioink formulations and their biocompatibility.
summary_en.result: The survey concludes that further development of both printing technology and bioinks is needed for full biofabrication platforms.
summary_en.validation: This is a review paper without experimental validation.
